High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
On The 10 th Of January, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 823 of 2025
 Jagdish
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh

Appearance:
 Ms. Parvati Patel - Advocate for applicant.
Shri K.S. Patel - Panel Lawyer for State.

Order 
This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.166/2022 registered at Police Station - Digoda, District Tikamgarh (M.P.)
for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 34 of IPC.
Applicant is in detention since 20.12.2024.
2. As per the prosecution story, allegation against the applicant is of committing fraud upon the complainant.
On the basis of which, offence under aforesaid sections has been registered against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 20.12.2024.
He is innocent and has been falsely implicated.

It is submitted that earlier the police has released the applicant after giving notice under Section 41(A) of Cr.P.C. At the time of filing of charge-sheet, he was not properly informed and thereafter arrest warrant was issued against him.
Since then he is in custody.
Offence is triable by JMFC.
Charge sheet has been filed.
There is no criminal record of applicant.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:1221 2 MCRC-823-2025 the trial.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

sentences.text: It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
